card.name: Education text and phone number gaps
card.fires_on: Small words in text about high school or college diplomas and education, and spaces or hyphens inside phone numbers. The marked word is often 'a', 'more', or 'to' just before a school-related phrase.

modes.label: Education advice text

modes.label: Phone number pieces
modes.description: A space, digit or hyphen inside a phone number after a country or area code.
